rationale: Invented direct-versus-incidental component and same-API boundary. The defect is cross-partition storage deletion. Candidate #810601 fails to remove target storage and #810602 removes a different storage type within the target partition; both explicitly preserve other partitions. app, BrowserWindow and webContents are reproduction scaffolding. Runnable app code supplied.

candidate_evidence.title: clearStorageData clears cookies despite selecting localstorage
candidate_evidence.excerpt: Within the same persist:alpha partition, clearStorageData({storages:['localstorage']}) also removes cookies. Other partitions are unchanged.

candidate_evidence.title: clearStorageData leaves target partition localstorage intact
candidate_evidence.excerpt: session.fromPartition('persist:alpha').clearStorageData({storages:['localstorage']}) leaves alpha's own stored keys intact. Other partitions are unchanged.
